description: Live-verify backlinks: fetches linking domains' homepages RIGHT NOW and confirms an actual href to the target domain exists on each. Complements the index with real-time proof. Only homepages are fetched, so 'not_found' means 'no link on the homepage today', not 'the link is gone'. Checks the top 8 linkers by default (max 15).

domain.description: Root domain whose backlinks to verify, e.g. 'stripe.com'.

limit.description: Optional: how many top linkers to check when 'linkers' is omitted (default 8, max 15).

linkers.description: Optional: specific linking domains to check (max 15). Defaults to the top linkers from the graph.

name: verify_link_live
title: Verify backlinks live
